The test suite in this repository fails.

```
$ python -m pytest tests/ -q

        text = "one two three four\n\nfive six seven"
>       assert wrap_text(text, 9) == "one two\nthree\nfour\n\nfive six\nseven"
E       AssertionError: assert 'one two\nthr...ve six\nseven' == 'one two\nthr...ve six\nseven'
```

Fix the source so that the suite passes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
- Do not add new dependencies; the standard library is all that is available.
- Keep the public API of the `solution` package unchanged: `wrap_text`.
diff:
diff --git a/solution/core.py b/solution/core.py
index 1c8dcb1..63b1744 100644
--- a/solution/core.py
+++ b/solution/core.py
@@ -37,4 +37,4 @@ def wrap_text(text: str, width: int) -> str:
     if current:
         paragraphs.append(current)
     blocks = ["\n".join(_wrap_paragraph(words, width)) for words in paragraphs]
-    return "\n".join(blocks)
+    return "\n\n".join(blocks)
summary:
The cause is in `wrap_text`: paragraphs are rendered separately but joined with a single `"
"`, so the blank line between paragraphs is lost. Fixing the join to `"

"`.
